{"text":"ItemID: unavailable; Title: Ride the Lightning; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic thrash fits my heavier listening, but I would choose something closer to my recent favorites today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Master of Puppets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The heavy riffs and intricate songs appeal to my interest in both metal and more elaborate arrangements.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: American Idiot Import       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have enjoyed accessible rock, but punk rock is less appealing than heavier music right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Vile       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My heavier albums suggest some openness to aggression, but this feels more relentlessly brutal than I want today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: City of Evil       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its melodic vocals and energetic metal guitar work fit the mix of hard rock and metal in my history.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: St. Anger       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The raw, repetitive sound is less appealing to me than the melody and detailed arrangements in my recent listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Lateralus; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having recently listened to 10.000 Days, I am especially interested in more Tool and its layered, shifting rhythms.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Cowboys from Hell; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The forceful riffs suit my heavier tastes, but other albums on this page feel more immediately compelling.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Dirt       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its dark, melodic heaviness fits my hard-rock listening, though I am leaning toward more intricate metal today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Art of Balance; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The balance of melody and aggressive riffs connects well with my interest in In Flames and heavier guitar music."}
